data.gist: Because tissue-preserving BMAX had never been tested in vivo against BMAC, the authors compared them in rat DMM osteoarthritis, hypothesizing ECM preservation enhances efficacy.
data.plain: BMAC comes from blood-diluted aspirated fluid and largely misses bone-adherent stem cells, whereas BMAX keeps intact marrow tissue and its niche; whether this helps in living animals had not been tested. The authors compared the two in a rat post-traumatic osteoarthritis model and report that BMAX improved pain behavior, swelling, and cartilage preservation relative to BMAC.
